method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Global stocks head for best week since May; US jobs data shifts rate outlook
Equities.reason: Broad market momentum positive — stocks rallying into quarter-end with macro (US jobs) reshaping the rate outlook. This is a market-wide regime signal (risk-on) and directly relevant to equity positioning.

Equities.title: US equity funds draw inflows as tech buying resumes
Equities.reason: Flows into US equity funds and renewed tech buying reinforce the dominant market narrative of tech/AI leadership driving equity demand — a meaningful positive for broad equities and cyclicality in market leadership.

Equities.title: CPP Invests $1.75 Billion in EQT’s AI Infrastructure Buildout
Equities.reason: Large institutional capital committed to AI infrastructure is a high-conviction, market-structural positive for AI-related equities (data centers, cloud, semiconductor demand) and signals durable investor appetite for the theme.

Equities.title: The hunt for AI's next winners defined the stock market's holiday-shortened week
Equities.summary: Wall Street kicked off the third quarter with mixed results after a blockbuster first half for stocks.
Equities.reason: Reinforces the dominant equity narrative: AI leadership is front-and-center in driving market moves and stock selection, supporting concentration in winners and risk appetite for related sectors.

Equities.title: Small Stocks Are Having Their Biggest Run in Decades
Equities.reason: Broadening of the rally into small caps indicates improving market breadth — a confirming positive for equity risk sentiment beyond mega-cap AI names.

Equities.title: Investors Looking for Shelter From AI Storm Are Turning to India
Equities.reason: Regional rotation narrative: some investors reallocating to India as a hedge against concentrated AI exposures. Positive for India equities and signals diversification within global equity flows.

Equities.title: US Stocks Post Largest Outflows in Over Three Months, BofA Says
Equities.reason: A notable short-term outflow signal that counters the inflow/AI momentum narrative; treated as a lower-relevance, but potentially meaningful, liquidity headwind for equities.

Equities.title: The AI trade is losing one of its key signals
Equities.reason: A weakening of a signal that supported the AI equity trade is a modest negative for sentiment toward AI names; treated as an incremental counter-signal with limited market-moving weight.

Equities.title: Wall St Week Ahead Investors look for Fed clues, earnings signs as tech wobbles
Equities.reason: Near-term risk: Fed policy and upcoming earnings remain key uncertainty drivers. This tempers bullish flow narratives and keeps rate/earnings sensitivity elevated for equities.

Rates.title: Bank of Japan: Wage data backs rates hike path – Wells Fargo
Rates.summary: Wells Fargo Economics expects Japan’s May labor cash earnings to confirm a sustained wage-price cycle, supporting Bank of Japan (BoJ) policy normalization.
Rates.reason: Wage data that supports a sustained wage-price cycle increases the likelihood of BoJ policy normalization and higher JGB yields. In the bond-price framework, this is a negative signal (yields up) for Rates, and it has material relevance for the JGB market and global rate pricing.

Rates.title: Bank of England : DMP expectations and MPC stance – TD Securities
Rates.summary: TD Securities strategists highlight that the June United Kingdom (UK) Decision Maker Panel (DMP) survey shows one‑year inflation expectations easing while three‑year expectations stay near 3%.
Rates.reason: Easing one‑year inflation expectations point to less near‑term upside for BoE rates (supportive for gilts), while three‑year expectations near 3% keep medium‑term inflation risks alive. Net effect is a small positive for bonds (yields slightly lower), with modest relevance to short‑term rate pricing

Rates.title: Isabel Schnabel: Is inflation back?
Rates.reason: A central‑bank commentary framed as questioning whether inflation is returning signals upside risk to euro‑area rates. That reinforces a higher‑for‑longer narrative for sovereign yields (negative for bond prices) and is of meaningful relevance to EUR rates pricing.

Rates.title: Christine Lagarde: Back to basics in an uncertain environment
Rates.reason: A senior ECB speech on policy in an uncertain environment typically signals the governing council's reaction function; here it suggests policy vigilance and supports the higher‑for‑longer EUR rates narrative (negative for bond prices) with material relevance.

Rates.title: ECB Consumer Expectations Survey results – May 2026
Rates.reason: Consumer inflation expectations are a lead indicator for inflation persistence; survey releases that suggest elevated expectations increase upside risk to yields. This is a direct input into euro‑area rates expectations (negative for bond prices) with moderate relevance.

Rates.title: Job seekers giving up: Labor force participation rate falls to lowest in 50 years, outside of Covid era
Rates.summary: A drop in the unemployment rate helped provide some upside to what was an otherwise downbeat jobs report — but it was for all the wrong reasons.
Rates.reason: A weakening labor‑force participation rate that depresses the quality of job gains tends to reduce policy tightening pressure and is supportive for US Treasuries (yields lower). This U.S. labour market nuance is moderately relevant for Fed rate expectations and global rates flows.

FX.title: Chinese Yuan: Bulls extend gains on PMI resilience – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Societe Generale notes that stronger-than-expected China PMI data suggest slow but steady growth, reducing urgency for the PBoC to ease policy. The bank highlights that USD/CNY has fallen back below its 50-day moving average as Yuan strength reflects robust ex
FX.reason: PMI surprise reinforces CNY strength and reduces near-term PBoC easing risk; USD/CNY dipping below the 50-day MA is a clear FX-native signal supporting further RMB appreciation (material EMFX flow / risk-significant).

FX.title: Euro: Slightly reduced upside as policy paths diverge – ABN AMRO
FX.summary: ABN AMRO’s Bill Diviney expects the US Dollar to weaken broadly but notes slightly less upside for EUR/USD after revising the bank’s ECB outlook and incorporating French and US election risks.
FX.reason: Bank note flags broadly weaker USD but trims EUR upside due to ECB outlook revision and election risks — a modest EUR-positive but tempered macro view (medium relevance for EUR/USD positioning).

FX.title: Euro struggles to extend gains as traders reassess Fed and ECB outlook
FX.summary: EUR/USD holds onto modest gains on Friday but struggles to extend its advance as the US Dollar (USD) stabilizes following Thursday's weaker-than-expected US jobs report. Market activity remains subdued as US financial markets are closed for the Independence Da
FX.reason: EUR gains look fragile as USD stabilisation pressures the pair; short-term USD resilience vs EUR is the dominant immediate market signal. Relevant for near-term EUR/USD moves.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar edges lower amid falling Oil, softer US jobs data
FX.summary: USD/CAD trades higher on Friday, rising 0.13% to near 1.4200 at the time of writing. The pair remains supported as persistent weakness in the Canadian Dollar (CAD) outweighs the pressure on the US Dollar (USD) following softer-than-expected US labor market dat
FX.reason: CAD weakness (USD/CAD up) driven by falling oil and domestic weakness outweighs softer US jobs—commodity-to-FX transmission is explicit, making this a clear CAD-negative / USD-positive FX signal.

FX.title: British Pound holds weekly gains as Fed hike doubts deepen
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) steadies against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, but it is poised to end the week with gains of over 1% as investors turn skeptical that the Federal Reserve (Fed) will raise interest rates at its September meeting.
FX.reason: Fed-hike doubt flow has weakened the USD, supporting GBP/USD outperformance; this is a clear USD-versus-G7 rate-expectations FX narrative with meaningful relevance for GBP positioning.

FX.title: Forecasting the upcoming week: US Dollar's resilience faces Fed minutes and jobless claims
FX.summary: The upcoming week will bring a fresh test for major currency pairs as investors return from the US Independence Day holiday and continue to digest weaker US labor market data.
FX.reason: Event calendar note: Fed minutes and jobless claims could dent recent USD resilience—relevant for short-term flows but non-specific on directional conviction so given low-medium relevance.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention risk rises at multi-decade lows – ABN AMRO
FX.summary: ABN AMRO’s Georgette Boele warns that USD/JPY trading near multi-decade highs has heightened the risk of intervention in the Japanese Yen (JPY). She notes markets are long Dollars and extremely short Yen, leaving room for a sharp reversal if sentiment shifts.
FX.reason: Intervention risk is a high-impact FX-native event: potential policy/FX support for JPY could trigger sharp USD/JPY moves and rapid re-pricing of risk positions. High relevance and strong directional implications for JPY strength.

FX.title: Japanese Yen holds steady amid US Independence Day holiday
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair posts modest gains on Friday amid thin trading due to the US Independence Day holiday. The US Dollar (USD) stabilizes against the Japanese Yen (JPY) after a sharp decline on Thursday following softer-than-expected United States (US) labor mark
FX.reason: Thin holiday liquidity produced a modest USD bounce vs JPY (USD/JPY up); short-term USD strength versus JPY but low structural signal—relevant mainly for intraday flows.

FX.title: Swiss Franc eyes first weekly gain in five weeks as weak NFP delays Fed hikes
FX.summary: USD/CHF heads for its first weekly loss in five weeks as weaker-than-expected US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data released on Thursday weighed on the US Dollar (USD). The pair rebounds on Friday as the Greenback stabilizes, with traders reassessing the Federal Rese
FX.reason: Weaker NFP reduces Fed hike odds and supports CHF vs USD (USD/CHF down on the week). Clear rate-expectation transmission into FX for a G10 safe-haven currency.

FX.title: Australian Dollar rises after upbeat PMIs improve sentiment
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair climbs near the 0.6940 level on Friday as the US Dollar (USD) remains under pressure following softer-than-expected United States (US) labor market data released on Thursday.
FX.reason: AUD supported by domestic PMI strength and a softer USD; a typical risk-on / USD-weakness transmission into AUD/USD with clear FX relevance.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar strengthens as weaker US labor market weighs on US Dollar
FX.summary: NZD/USD trades around 0.5710 at the time of writing on Friday, up 0.21% on the day, supported by improved risk sentiment and a weaker US Dollar (USD) following a softer-than-expected US employment report.
FX.reason: NZD benefitted from weaker US labor data and improved risk sentiment; relevant for Antipodean FX flows but lower market-wide impact than G7 moves.

Commodities.title: Gold eyes first weekly gain in five weeks as weak US NFP delays Fed hike bets
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) extends gains on Friday as weaker-than-expected US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data released on Thursday batters the US Dollar (USD) and cools expectations of an imminent Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate hike.
Commodities.reason: Weaker-than-expected US NFP is a major macro driver that typically weakens the USD and pushes bullion higher. High relevance because NFP materially alters Fed rate expectations and immediate gold flows.

Commodities.title: Gold: Price rebound seen as corrective – Commerzbank
Commodities.summary: Commerzbank’s Carsten Fritsch notes that the Gold price has rebounded toward USD 4,200 per ounce after steep second-quarter losses, helped by weaker US labour data and reduced rate hike expectations.
Commodities.reason: Analyst view that the rebound may be corrective tempers the bullish NFP-driven move. Useful market-structure/counter-signal but lower relevance than the macro data itself.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG reclaims $60 as RSI recovery targets $65 breakout
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) prices reclaim the $60.00 mark for the second straight day on Friday, extending their weekly gains to over 5.50% and trading at $62.42 amid broader US Dollar weakness, pushing the white metal to an eight-day high of $62.89.
Commodities.reason: Silver is rallying alongside gold on USD weakness; item is technical/price-forecast oriented so given lower relevance despite confirming the broader precious-metal move.

Commodities.title: Copper: Tariff risks and Chile supply strain – Commerzbank
Commodities.summary: Commerzbank analyst Norman Liebke reports that the Copper market is focused on a potential 15% US import tariff on refined Copper, which could temporarily boost US demand and prices if implemented in 2027.
Commodities.reason: Tariff risk and Chile supply strain are direct fundamental drivers for copper. The potential tariff and supply-side concerns are supportive for prices but timing/implementation uncertainty keeps relevance moderate.

Commodities.title: OPEC+ to Ratify Planned Oil Quota Hike as Gulf Flows Resume
Commodities.reason: OPEC+ quota increases imply added crude supply at a time of already growing flows; high relevance because OPEC+ policy decisions are primary drivers of oil prices.

Commodities.title: Oil’s Supply Wave, Tumbling Prices Rekindle Fears of Global Glut
Commodities.reason: Headline frames a market moving from risk premium to oversupply concerns; negative for crude with solid relevance as it captures the prevailing supply-dominant narrative.

Commodities.title: OPEC Output Surged in June as Hormuz Flows Jumped, Survey Shows
Commodities.reason: Rising OPEC output and resumed Hormuz flows increase physical availability and weigh on oil prices; moderate-high relevance for markets focused on supply metrics.

Commodities.title: Oil market opens up as retail traders pour in
Commodities.summary: CME Group to launch 10-barrel contract after Iran war triggers rush of bets on crude prices
Commodities.reason: Increased retail/speculative participation and new micro-contracts can amplify crude volatility and intraday demand for contracts; modest positive for near-term activity but lower fundamental relevance.

Commodities.title: Modi Says India Will Keep Expanding Oil Refining Capacity
Commodities.reason: Longer-term increase in refining capacity in a major importer supports crude demand prospects; relevant but more structural and medium-term in nature.

Commodities.title: Oil Terminal in Russia’s St. Petersburg Comes Under Drone Attack
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical/physical-disruption risk to oil infrastructure lifts risk premium for crude; material for immediate market sentiment though localized in scope.

Commodities.title: Oman walks a diplomatic tightrope over Strait of Hormuz fees, creating a ‘blind spot’ for markets
Commodities.summary: Oman is using strategic ambiguity as talks over possible Strait of Hormuz fees raise legal, diplomatic and oil market concerns.
Commodities.reason: Diplomatic ambiguity around Hormuz fees creates a potential market blind spot and episodic risk premium for oil; noted but lower immediate relevance.

Commodities.title: U.S. refining capacity decreased during 2025
Commodities.summary: U.S. operable atmospheric distillation capacity, the primary measure of refinery capacity, totaled 18.2 million barrels per calendar day (b/cd) on January 1, 2026-down over 250,000 b/cd (about 1%) compared with January 1, 2025-according to our latest annual Re
Commodities.reason: A decline in US refining capacity reduces domestic crude demand and can exert downward pressure on oil balances/prices; moderate relevance to near-term crude fundamentals.

Commodities.title: Oil: Market expectations diverge from data – Commerzbank
Commodities.summary: Commerzbank’s Commodity Research team, led by Norman Liebke and colleagues, notes that Oil prices have fallen as optimism grows over US–Iran talks and a potential reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.
Commodities.reason: Analyst note tying oil weakness to improving diplomatic prospects and reopening of Hormuz flows; a relevant corroboration of the supply-led downside narrative.

Commodities.title: Safe havens aren't behaving like they used to. Here's what's changed
Commodities.summary: Traditional safe-haven assets — U.S. Treasurys, the Japanese yen and gold — have struggled to provide protection during this year’s market volatility.
Commodities.reason: If safe-haven properties are weakening, that limits gold's structural demand as a hedge and is a modestly negative, lower-relevance counterpoint to short-term NFP-driven bullion strength.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin whales bought $16.7 billion of bitcoin in 2 weeks even as ETFs bled a record $4 billion
Crypto.reason: Large on-chain accumulation by whales signals strong institutional/large-holder demand and liquidity support for BTC despite ETF outflows — positive for price formation and market structure.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin ETFs see $221 million inflow, finally ending a painful 10-day selling streak
Crypto.reason: ETF inflows ending a multi-day outflow streak are a direct liquidity positive for BTC and reduce near-term technical pressure from product-level selling.

Crypto.title: Crypto bulls on firmer footing as U.S. rate-hike risk recedes
Crypto.reason: Macro backdrop (lowered US rate-hike risk) is a high‑impact regime driver for risk assets; reduced policy tightening risk materially supports crypto allocation and risk appetite.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin jumps above $63,000, reversing end-June losses
Crypto.reason: A clear price breakout above near-term resistance reflects renewed buying momentum and helps restore risk-on positioning in the crypto complex.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin, ether traders aren't fully buying the bounce, options markets show
Crypto.reason: Options positioning and trader skepticism suggest limited conviction behind the rally — implies fragility and potential for mean reversion in short term.

Crypto.title: How ethical hackers with just a $3,000 server found a flaw that could've put $70 billion in crypto at risk
Crypto.reason: Newly exposed systemic security vulnerabilities raise counterparty and custody risk across the ecosystem — negative for confidence, could increase risk premia and reduce flows.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin experts split over plan to freeze Satoshi's 1.1 million bitcoin as quantum threat grows
Crypto.reason: Governance and long‑duration security debates (quantum risk, proposals to freeze historic coins) add uncertainty and narrative risk even if not immediately market‑moving.

Crypto.title: Nearly a Million Investors Lost a Total of $3.8 Billion on Trump Crypto Coin
Crypto.reason: High‑profile retail losses from a widely publicized token amplify regulatory and reputational risks for the sector, potentially depressing retail inflows and political tolerance.

Crypto.title: UK's bold new crypto rules promise to unlock global trading, but huge compliance hurdles still threaten the rollout
Crypto.reason: Regulatory clarity in a major capital market (UK) is structurally positive for institutional access and global liquidity, though implementation risk tempers the near‑term impact.

Crypto.title: Tokenization's next use case is personalized portfolios, NYLIM executive says
Crypto.reason: Tokenization enabling personalized portfolios is an incremental adoption story that expands use cases and institutional interest — positive long‑term but modest near‑term impact.

Crypto.title: This sanctioned Russian stablecoin claims it processes billions, but blockchain analysts disagree
Crypto.reason: Sanctioned stablecoin activity raises counterparty and compliance concerns, increasing regulatory scrutiny and potential frictions in cross‑border flows.

Crypto.title: Memory and semiconductor stocks lose momentum, bitcoin rebounds in sign of changing investor focus
Crypto.reason: Cross‑asset rotation away from semiconductors toward crypto suggests shifting investor risk appetite and capital reallocation into digital assets.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin’s next parabolic run may need $1 trillion in fresh capital
Crypto.reason: Structural commentary on required fresh capital highlights scale constraints for a major new leg higher — mildly positive but primarily a long‑term framing piece.
